_comment: Hand-written, not captured from Zendesk. Minimal Zendesk ticket shape so they go through the real to_ticket_row. Every ticket is tagged 'synthetic'. IDs 101+ never collide with the captured fixture (1-7). acme-test exists only to prove tenant isolation: its tickets deliberately share words (login, billing, refund) with local-dev.

local-dev.subject: Refund for annual plan
local-dev.description: I upgraded to the annual plan by mistake yesterday. I wanted monthly. Can I get a refund for the difference?

local-dev.subject: Invoice missing VAT number
local-dev.description: Our finance team needs the company VAT number printed on every invoice. The October invoice does not show it.

local-dev.subject: card declined but money left my account
local-dev.description: payment failed on the checkout page and it said card declined, but my bank shows the charge as pending. please check

local-dev.subject: Cancel subscription
local-dev.description: Please cancel my subscription at the end of this billing period. We moved to another tool.

local-dev.subject: want my money back
local-dev.description: I paid for 3 seats and only use 1. I want the money for the other two returned.

local-dev.subject: Two-factor code never arrives
local-dev.description: The SMS with the two-factor authentication code never arrives on my phone, so I am locked out of my account.

local-dev.subject: SSO with Okta fails
local-dev.description: After enabling SAML single sign-on with Okta, all our users get 'invalid assertion' when signing in.

local-dev.subject: can't sign in on the new laptop
local-dev.description: Works on my old computer but on the new laptop the sign-in page just reloads after I enter my password.

local-dev.subject: Password reset email goes to spam
local-dev.description: The password reset email lands in our spam folder every time. Gmail marks it as suspicious.

local-dev.subject: CSV export is empty
local-dev.description: When I export the reports page to CSV the file downloads but it only has the header row, no data.

local-dev.subject: Dashboard takes 30 seconds to load
local-dev.description: Since last week the main dashboard is extremely slow. Sometimes it times out completely.

local-dev.subject: Calendar sync duplicates events
local-dev.description: The Google Calendar integration creates every event twice. We now have hundreds of duplicates.

local-dev.subject: notifications stopped
local-dev.description: i dont get any email notifications anymore when someone comments on my project

local-dev.subject: Mobile app crashes on Android 15
local-dev.description: The app closes immediately after the splash screen on my Pixel running Android 15.

local-dev.subject: Times shown in wrong time zone
local-dev.description: All due dates show in UTC even though my profile time zone is set to Pacific time.

local-dev.subject: Feature request: dark mode
local-dev.description: Please add a dark mode. Many of our team work late and the white screen is hard on the eyes.

local-dev.subject: Need an API for bulk import
local-dev.description: We want to import 50,000 contacts. Is there an API or bulk import option instead of the one-at-a-time form?

local-dev.subject: API returns 429 too often
local-dev.description: Our integration hits HTTP 429 rate limit errors at only 20 requests per minute. What are the actual limits?

local-dev.subject: Delete my account and data
local-dev.description: Under GDPR I request that you erase my account and all personal data you hold about me.

local-dev.subject: Where is my data stored?
local-dev.description: Our security team needs to know which region and cloud provider stores our data before we sign.

local-dev.subject: Add a teammate
local-dev.description: How do I invite a new teammate to our workspace? I can't find the button.

local-dev.subject: Change the account owner
local-dev.description: Our admin left the company. We need to transfer workspace ownership to another person.

local-dev.subject: this is the third time I'm writing
local-dev.description: Nobody has answered my previous two tickets about the double charge. This is unacceptable, I will dispute it with my bank.

local-dev.subject: Upload fails for large files
local-dev.description: Uploading a 200MB video fails at about 90% with a network error. Smaller files are fine.

local-dev.subject: Thanks for the quick fix
local-dev.description: Just wanted to say the export bug is fixed now. Thanks to the support team!

acme-test.subject: ACME: login broken for all staff
acme-test.description: Nobody at Acme can log in since this morning. The login page shows a blank screen.

acme-test.subject: ACME: billing address wrong on invoice
acme-test.description: Acme's billing address on the invoice is our old office. Please update it.

acme-test.subject: ACME: refund request
acme-test.description: Acme requests a refund for the unused seats on last month's billing.

acme-test.subject: ACME: CSV export is empty
acme-test.description: Same as everyone else maybe: Acme's CSV export has only the header row.
